name: Calendar
description_en:
Calendar at calendar.com combines a unified calendar view, shareable booking links and team scheduling. It is a specific commercial product rather than a generic label for Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Microsoft Outlook. Those services can be connected sources within its workflow.

The practical starting question is which calendars should block availability and where a new booking should appear. Contact records, analytics and automation extend that core, while the homepage labels task management and bundle payments as beta capabilities. Treat those labels as maturity boundaries when planning adoption.
description_zh:
calendar.com 的 Calendar 结合统一日历视图、可分享预约链接与团队排程。它是具体商业产品，不是 Google Calendar、Apple Calendar 或 Microsoft Outlook 的通用名称；这些服务可以作为连接来源。

实际入门应先确定哪些日历阻挡可预约时间、新预约写到哪里。联系人、分析与自动化扩展这一核心流程；首页把任务管理和套餐付款标为 beta。规划采用时应注意这些成熟度边界。

core_features.explanation_en: View calendars from multiple providers and retain source-specific distinctions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 合并查看多个服务的日历，并保留来源区别。

core_features.explanation_en: Find shared availability and distribute bookings using configured team rules.
core_features.explanation_zh: 寻找共同空闲时间，并按配置的团队规则分配预约。

sections.title_en: Example: a consultant with work and personal calendars
sections.title_zh: 示例：工作与个人日历并存的顾问
sections.en:
A consultant can connect work and personal calendars, configure an event duration and availability, then send a scheduling link. A visitor selects a time and receives an invitation. The vendor describes private events blocking time without exposing their details; verify that behavior with a representative private event before relying on it.

Check the booking from both sides: the visitor’s local time, the consultant’s calendar and the event location or conferencing link. A unified display is not by itself proof that every sub-calendar is checked for conflicts. Decide which calendars are sources of availability and which receive newly created meetings.
sections.zh:
顾问可以连接工作与个人日历，设置事件时长及可预约时间，再发送排程链接。访问者选时段并收到邀请。厂商表示私人事件可阻挡时间而不公开详情；依赖此功能前，应使用代表性私人事件核实。

应从双方检查预约：访问者当地时间、顾问日历，以及事件地点或会议链接。统一显示本身不能证明每个子日历都参与冲突检查。应指定哪些日历决定可用性，哪些接收新建会议。

sections.en:
The product describes even, weighted and priority-based routing, as well as shared availability. A fair rotation and a specialist-first policy solve different problems. For a sales team, define eligible hosts and the expected distribution before evaluating the routing setting.

Use an absence and a fully occupied calendar in the acceptance scenario. Confirm what happens if no eligible host has a slot. The public descriptions do not establish a universal fallback, duplicate prevention or retry policy. An automation chain also needs a named owner to inspect missing follow-ups.
sections.zh:
产品介绍平均、加权及按优先级路由，以及共同可用性。公平轮换与优先专家处理解决的是不同问题。销售团队应先定义合格主持人及预期分配，再评估路由设置。

验收建议包含缺勤和日历完全占用的情况，确认无人可用时的行为。公开说明不能证明通用回退、去重或重试政策。自动化链也应有负责检查遗漏跟进的维护者。

sections.title_en: User pricing and a calendar-limit discrepancy
sections.title_zh: 用户计费与日历额度差异
sections.en:
The pricing page shows Standard starting at $20 per month and Pro at $30, with a user multiplier calculator and monthly/annual controls. Standard permits up to ten users per workspace, Pro thirty, and Enterprise uses a custom offer. The selected billing period, currency code and total need confirmation at checkout; a starting figure is not the cost for the whole team.

There is a material source inconsistency: plan cards say six connected calendars on Standard and ten on Pro, while detailed rows show three and six connected sync/availability calendars. This profile does not pick the larger entitlement. Ask the vendor to confirm the actual limit for the intended account. Pro lists SSO as an add-on; Enterprise lists SSO and SCIM. Do not infer enterprise access control from the base subscription.
sections.zh:
定价页显示 Standard 每月 $20 起、Pro 每月 $30 起，配有用户数量乘数及月付/年付控制。Standard 每工作区最多十位用户，Pro 三十位，Enterprise 为定制方案。结算时需确认计费周期、货币代码及总额，起价不是整个团队的成本。

来源存在实质矛盾：套餐卡片写 Standard 六个连接日历、Pro 十个；详细表格的同步/可用性日历行却分别为三个与六个。本文不选择更高权益，应向厂商确认目标账户的实际限制。Pro 把 SSO 列为附加项，Enterprise 列出 SSO 和 SCIM，不能从基础订阅推定企业访问控制。

sections.title_en: Setup, failure checks and product scope
sections.title_zh: 配置、失败检查与产品边界
sections.en:
Begin with one provider connection, one event type and one invited test participant. Authorize only the intended accounts and inspect private event handling. Then add team routing and follow-up automation separately so a missing calendar write can be distinguished from a missing downstream notification. These are evaluation recommendations; no account was created here.

The source describes a hosted product with mobile applications and browser extensions, not an established self-hosted distribution. Beta payment bundles should not be treated as a replacement for a verified billing system. No refund, retention, export, contractual licence or disaster-recovery behavior was verified.
sections.zh:
先连接一个日历服务，创建一种事件，并邀请一位测试参与者。仅授权计划使用的账户，检查私人事件处理；再分别加入团队路由及跟进自动化，以区分日历写入遗漏和下游通知遗漏。这是评估建议，本文未创建账户。

来源介绍带移动应用和浏览器扩展的托管产品，未证明存在自托管发行版。beta 付款套餐不能直接当作已验证计费系统的替代。未核实退款、保留、导出、合同许可或灾难恢复行为。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Examples and evaluation recommendations were not executed.

research_gaps.en: Connected-calendar limits conflict between plan cards and detailed rows; no account entitlement was checked.
research_gaps.zh: 套餐卡片与详细表格的日历连接数矛盾，未核实账户实际权益。

research_gaps.en: Currency code, final billing, beta functionality, privacy behavior, export, licence, failure recovery and provider-specific permissions were not tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试货币代码、最终计费、beta 功能、隐私行为、导出、许可、恢复及具体日历服务权限。
